metaTitle: Custom Adjustable Luggage ID Tags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom adjustable luggage ID tags for your team. Secure, versatile tags with easy-to-adjust straps at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Adjustable luggage ID tags give your team the flexibility to attach them securely to any bag, from carry-ons to checked suitcases. Unlike fixed-loop tags, the adjustable strap fits handles of different thicknesses, making them ideal for frequent travelers. The BioBlend™ Luggage Tag offers a sleek silicone design, while The Goods Recycled Felt Tag provides an eco-friendly option. Both can be customized with your logo using screen printing or debossing.
heroAltText: Custom adjustable luggage ID tags with secure straps and personalized logo imprint
